title: TABOR CHIPS — ENHANCED NATHAN AI SOVEREIGN SUPERCOMPUTER
preservation: Additive extension of existing master continuation map; no NVIDIA or previous Tabor components removed
principles: Tabor Chips is a distinct proposed design family; vendor reference architectures are comparison inputs, not copied proprietary RTL.
Preserve every physical and virtual subsystem as a separate design track.
The cloud control plane does not substitute for physical semiconductor manufacturing.
Do not claim fabricated silicon, demonstrated benchmarks, or measured 2x improvement without evidence.
Each layer has interfaces, test benches, agent ownership and a continuation tag.
